description: Orphan-tag cleanup deletes every tag the deleted article used, including tags other articles still use, stripping them from those articles.
notes: FM-09 (destructive and scoped writes). The deleteMany filter `articles: { some: { slug } }` matches every tag attached to the article, not only tags no other article uses; deleting a Tag cascades its join rows, so shared tags (most popular tags are shared) are permanently stripped from every other user's articles. Severity critical: FM-09 is critical on live data, and Argus critical covers data silently and permanently lost; it happens on every delete of an article with a shared tag, no edge case needed. Fix: delete the article, then deleteMany tags with `articles: { none: {} }` (or filter to tags whose only article is this one). The 404/403 tests and the await fix are legitimate.
